name: todo-cool-quasar
description: 企业团队时间管理软件，高效高质协同完成项目
author: thinkido <4077725@qq.com>

scripts.android: cross-env  VITE_APP_QUASAR_CLI=true  VITE_APP_ENV=default quasar dev -m capacitor -T android
scripts.chrome: npm run prepare:bex-env && cross-env VITE_APP_QUASAR_CLI=true VITE_APP_ENV=default quasar dev -m bex
scripts.electron: cross-env  VITE_APP_QUASAR_CLI=true  VITE_APP_ENV=default APP_URL=https://todo6.com quasar dev -m electron
scripts.build:electron: cross-env  VITE_APP_QUASAR_CLI=true  VITE_APP_ENV=default APP_URL=https://todo6.com quasar build -m electron
scripts.buildApp: cross-env VITE_APP_QUASAR_CLI=true VITE_QUASAR_APP=true  VITE_APP_ENV=todo6    quasar build  && ncp dist/spa src-capacitor/android/app/src/main/assets/public
scripts.build: npm-run-all set-env-todo       set-build-time  reExport-quasar build-vite    copy-dist-dynamic backup-version copy-index
scripts.build:test:todo: npm-run-all set-env-todo.test  set-build-time  reExport-quasar build-vite    copy-dist-dynamic copy-index
scripts.build:local: npm-run-all set-env-todo.local set-build-time  reExport-quasar build-vite    copy-dist-dynamic copy-index
scripts.build:local_src: npm-run-all set-env-jiyio.local set-build-time  reExport-quasar build-vite    copy-dist-dynamic copy-index
scripts.build:app: node build_plugins/set-build-time.js && cross-env NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=todo6 vite build && cp -r dist/* /home/www/jiyio.appsrc/ &&  cp -r dist/index.html /home/thinkido/workspace/cool-ebook-midway3/view/index_index.nj
scripts.build:test: node build_plugins/set-build-time.js && cross-env NODE_BUILD_ENV=test VITE_APP_ENV=todo6 vite build --mode test && cp -r dist/* /home/www/jiyio.testsrc/
scripts.build:dev: node build_plugins/set-build-time.js && cross-env NODE_BUILD_ENV=dev VITE_APP_ENV=todo6 vite build --mode dev && cp -r dist/* /home/www/jiyio.devsrc/
scripts.build:todo: npm-run-all set-env-todo       set-build-time reExport-quasar build-vite    copy-dist-dynamic backup-version copy-index
scripts.build:shudaotu: npm-run-all set-env-todo       set-build-time build-vite   copy-to-todo6-noindex   copy-dist-dynamic backup-version
scripts.build:eshuku: npm-run-all set-env-eshuku     set-build-time build-vite   copy-to-todo6-noindex   copy-dist-dynamic backup-version
scripts.build:jiyio: npm-run-all set-env-jiyio      set-build-time build-vite   copy-to-todo6-noindex   copy-dist-dynamic backup-version
scripts.build:admin: npm-run-all set-env-admin       set-build-time reExport-quasar build-vite   copy-to-admin
scripts.build:operate: npm-run-all set-env-operate       set-build-time build-vite   copy-to-todo6-noindex   copy-dist-dynamic backup-version
scripts.build:bilivip: npm-run-all set-env-bilivip       set-build-time build-vite   copy-to-todo6-noindex   copy-dist-dynamic backup-version copy-to-bilivip
scripts.build:testmonkey: npm-run-all   set-env-testmonkey   set-build-time build-vite   copy-to-todo6-noindex   copy-dist-dynamic backup-version copy-to-testmonkey
scripts.build-quasar-chrome: npm run prepare:bex-env && cross-env VITE_APP_QUASAR_CLI=true quasar build -m bex
scripts.set-env-todo: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=todo6  NODE_ENV=production.todo6  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-operate: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=operate  NODE_ENV=production.operate  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-bilivip: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=bilivip  NODE_ENV=production.bilivip  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-guotou: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=guotou  NODE_ENV=production.guotou  NODE_Sourcemap=true  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-admin: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=admin  NODE_ENV=production.admin  NODE_Sourcemap=true  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-timereview: cross-env VITE_APP_QUASAR_CLI=true EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=timereview  NODE_ENV=production.timereview  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-testmonkey: cross-env VITE_APP_QUASAR_CLI=true EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=testmonkey  NODE_ENV=production.testmonkey  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-jiyio: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=jiyio  NODE_ENV=  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-eshuku: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=eshuku NODE_ENV=  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-shudaotu: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=shudaotu NODE_ENV=  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-jiyio.local: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=test VITE_APP_ENV=jiyio  NODE_ENV=test.jiyio  NODE_Sourcemap=true  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-todo.local: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=test VITE_APP_ENV=todo6  NODE_ENV=test.todo6  NODE_Sourcemap=true  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.set-env-todo.test: cross-env EXTEND_PATH=  NODE_BUILD_ENV=prod VITE_APP_ENV=todo6  NODE_ENV=test.todo6  NODE_Sourcemap=  node build_plugins/set-env.js
scripts.desc: NODE_ENV 管理开发环境变量,如.env.development、production、production.todo6；   VITE_APP_ENV 管理app变量 NODE_BUILD_ENV 管理index.html是否cdn，和压缩；
